svg.title: AREA 18
svg.desc: Yellow releases the left pair; their orange pad releases the right pair. Each side must be able to clear enemies. From the right-branch entrance use only the far-right pad, lowest on this map; avoid the other three. The left group clears enemies and takes pink before entering the long meeting room. On the right branch, use the left side of the U room, collect the round-room boxes, and open the gate to regroup. The right group opens the cage for the left. The left group presses the center pad to open the exit and reunite. The pre-boss door can open before all enemies die. Alert teammates and leave once it opens.
